item.title: Gold Mountain Defines Extensive Lithium-Gold Anomalies at Salinas South and Coroaci Prospects
item.description: Gold Mountain hits extensive lithium-gold anomalies across Salinas South and Coroaci in Brazil's Lithium Valley, with 12km lithium zones and 6-16km gold trends.

item.title: Belararox Bolsters TMT Drilling with Second Rig, Eyes Epithermal and Porphyry Targets
item.description: Belararox has significantly boosted its exploration capacity at the TMT project with the arrival of a second drill rig to expedite testing.

item.title: Native Mineral Resources Hits Significant High-Grade Gold at Blackjack, Eyes Mine Restart
item.description: Native Mineral Resources has announced significant high-grade gold intercepts at its Blackjack project, supporting plans for a near-term mine restart.

item.title: Codefai Completes Quantum Security Acquisition, Rebrands to QuantumAI Secure
item.description: Codeifai (ASX: CDE) has completed its acquisition of AntennaTransfer.io, rebranding it as QuantumAI Secure, to enter the AI-backed quantum security market.

item.title: Pacific Lime and Cement Signs Offtake Deal with Newmont for Central Lime Project in PNG
item.description: Pacific Lime inks long-term offtake with Newmont for PNG's Central Lime project, securing ~1/3 of capacity and kickstarting PNG's first domestic quicklime plant.

item.title: Fortifai Launches Roadmap for Nol8 Agentic AI Data Plane Following Acquisition
item.description: Fortifai (ASX: FTI) unveils Nol8 AI Data Plane roadmap after acquisition, boasting 160x latency drop and 400x throughput gains, aiming commercial launch by 2026

item.title: Emyria Introduces First Empax Centre to Victoria with Expanded Medibank Funding Agreement
item.description: Emyria expands Medibank funding to Victoria, unlocking Empax TRD/PTSD care at Avive Mornington Peninsula; nationwide rollout underway.

item.title: Askari Metals Intersects Polymetallic Mineralisation in Phase 1 Trenching at Uis Lithium Project
item.description: Askari Metals (ASX: AS2) reports high-grade polymetallic mineralisation at Uis, Namibia; Phase 1 trenching yields tin, lithium, tantalum, rubidium, caesium.

item.title: Genesis Minerals to Acquire Magnetic Resources for A$639 Million in All-Scrip and Cash Deal
item.description: Genesis Minerals is set to acquire Magnetic Resources for approximately A$639 million in a scrip and cash deal, significantly bolstering its production outlook and resource base.

item.title: Red Mountain Mining Commences Metallurgical Testing of Antimony Samples from Oaky Creek
item.description: RMX kicks off metallurgical testing on a 20kg Oaky Creek antimony sample to validate processing viability and de-risk the asset ahead of drilling.
